description: This Kotlin source file defines the SplashActivity class for an Android TV app. The activity displays a splash screen with a dark theme, preloads an image for smoother rendering, and transitions to the main activity after a delay. It manages handlers and image cache warm-up, with lifecycle-aware cleanup.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: A lightweight splash activity that displays a themed splash screen, preloads an image, and transitions to MainActivity after 3 seconds, managing lifecycle-safe handlers.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash screen, preloads an image into cache, and sets up delayed navigation to MainActivity.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes pending callbacks to prevent memory leaks when the activity is destroyed.
